name: read_draft
description: Return the current draft: title, lines by section, attached context, and whether it is coherent enough to send. Use when they ask what you have. Do not call it to decide whether to speak.

take_id.description: Take to read. Omit to use the active take.

include_rendered.description: Include the fully rendered prompt text. Only set this when they asked for the whole thing verbatim.
